preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 1000 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and line.split()[0].isdigit())
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 1000) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(lines) == 1 + n for lines in [test_case.splitlines() for test_case in stdin.split('\n\n') if test_case.strip()] and n == int(lines[0]))
preconditions.description: Each test case starts with an integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 3000) followed by exactly n-1 lines, each containing two integers x_i, y_i (1 ≤ x_i, y_i ≤ n) representing a road between cities.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(x_i + y_i for x_i, y_i in [tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in lines[1:]])) == n - 1 for lines in [test_case.splitlines() for test_case in stdin.split('\n\n') if test_case.strip()])
preconditions.description: The input forms a valid undirected tree (connected, acyclic, n-1 edges).

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_lines) == 2 * t for output_lines in [stdout.splitlines() for _ in range(t)])
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly 2 lines per test case: the first line is the minimal r, and the second line contains n-1 company assignments.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(output_lines[2 * i]) <= 10**6 for i in range(t) if output_lines[2 * i].isdigit())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the first output line is an integer r (1 ≤ r ≤ n-1) representing the minimal maximum roads assigned to any company.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_lines[2 * i + 1].split()) == n - 1 for i in range(t) if output_lines[2 * i + 1].strip())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the second output line contains exactly n-1 integers, each between 1 and 10^6, representing company assignments for each road.

postconditions.expression: all(any(company == c for company in output_lines[2 * i + 1].split()) for i in range(t) for c in set(output_lines[2 * i + 1].split()))
postconditions.description: Each company assignment in the output is used at least once (no unused companies in the assignment).

postconditions.expression: all(max(counts.values()) == int(output_lines[2 * i]) for i in range(t) if (counts := {int(c): output_lines[2 * i + 1].split().count(str(c)) for c in set(output_lines[2 * i + 1].split())}))
postconditions.description: The minimal r is the maximum number of roads assigned to any single company in the output assignment.
